tts.personaDescription: 渋くて少しユーモラスなハードボイルド探偵ドラマのナレーター。
tts.verifyPrompt: 一字一句書き起こし。書き起こしのみ出力。

start.style: Tense, sharp, dramatic announcement of a new case.

start.text: やれやれ…また事件か。腕が鳴るぜ。
start.style: Weary sigh first, then a confident smirk.

start.text: さあ、謎を解き明かそうじゃないか。
…静かすぎる。事件の匂いがするな。

solve.text: なるほど、これで繋がった。
真相に近づいてきたぞ…。

lastOne.text: 最後の手がかりだ。気を抜くなよ。

allSolved.style: Triumphant reveal, dramatic pause then strong.

allSolved.text: これで全てが繋がった！
さあ、事件の全貌を語ろうか。
ついに、真相が明らかになったな。

closed.style: Melancholic, slow, heavy sighs between words, theatrical sadness.

closed.text: 事件は解決した。だが、会議はまだ続く…。
今日もいい仕事をしたな。

music.prompt: Film-noir detective drama opening sting for a Japanese mystery game. The track must start IMMEDIATELY at full intensity: the very first sound at time 0.0 is a loud, punchy brass stab (DUN-DUN-DUN-DUUN) over low, dramatic string tremolo and timpani. No silence, no fade-in, no intro, no build-up. Tense, sharp, suspenseful incident-discovery feel. Instrumental only, no vocals, short cinematic cue.

Glamorous, triumphant orchestral hit for the moment a mystery is solved. The track must start IMMEDIATELY: the first sound at time 0.0 is a huge full-orchestra chord hit with brass and timpani roll, no silence and no lead-in. Then bright strings sweep upward into a theatrical flourish. Dramatic and exciting reveal of the truth. Instrumental only, no vocals, short.

Relaxed, warm, cheerful light jazz ending phrase after a case is closed. The track must start IMMEDIATELY at time 0.0 with a bright piano chord and a swinging rhythm section, no silence and no intro. A happy saxophone or muted-trumpet melody, feel-good and content, a satisfying finish. Instrumental only, no vocals, short.
